title: NVIDIA AIStore AuthN users Missing Authentication for Critical Function Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of NVIDIA AIStore. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the users endpoint. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored user names, leading to further compromise.
